deduplication.predecessorRelation: consumes the predecessor's capture receipt as its mandatory join key
deduplication.note: Keystone wave of the governed-inference lane chain: binding contract -> capture harness contract -> readout receipt contract. Satisfies the claim side of szl-holdings/a11oy#2020 steps 3-4 as a contract; performs no readout.

candidate.title: Workspace readout receipt contract v1
candidate.note: No readout exists yet; this wave defines what a readout receipt must carry so no workspace disposition field can appear on a DSSE receipt without full receipt ancestry.

joinKey.name: captureReceipt
joinKey.rule: Every readout receipt carries the capture receipt id it consumed, which itself carries the binding receipt id. A readout without valid capture ancestry is invalid by construction; the chain is binding -> capture -> readout, unbroken.

requiredFields.name: readoutMethod
requiredFields.rule: Named readout algorithm (J-lens-class or the documented closest implementable analog) with a pinned implementation version and pinned parameters. An unnamed or floating method cannot anchor a disposition.

requiredFields.name: coverageMap
requiredFields.rule: The layers and hook points the readout actually consumed, checked against the capture config hash; partial coverage is declared, never silently widened in claims.

requiredFields.name: dispositionField
requiredFields.rule: The workspace disposition travels as a labeled field on the DSSE receipt alongside the behavioral output, with schema: { property, state, method, captureReceiptId }. It never replaces the behavioral output and never outruns the coverage map.

requiredFields.name: unavailableSemantics
requiredFields.rule: Properties the provider does not expose (directed modulation, internal reasoning, generalization) read UNAVAILABLE on every receipt; an absent field is a contract violation, not an omission.

requiredFields.name: measuredUpgradeRule
requiredFields.rule: An estate organ flips MODELED -> MEASURED only when a readout receipt exists against this contract on a real bound route for that property; the flip is receipt-evidenced and reversible on receipt invalidation.

requiredFields.name: failureDisposition
requiredFields.rule: Readout failure, ancestry break, or method drift produces abstention: the disposition field reads UNAVAILABLE with the failure code; behavioral output alone is never presented as workspace evidence.

relationToLane.rule: Steps 3-4 of the measurement order are contractually satisfied by this wave; executional satisfaction requires the receipt chain binding -> capture -> readout on a real bound route.

claimSurfaces: No readout has run; no disposition field has been emitted; every estate organ remains MODELED or NO_ORGAN.
This wave changes no runtime; it defines the claim contract a future readout must satisfy.
The output is not the truth of the computation; a disposition field is a labeled observation, not a verdict.
